title: chore!: remove @object-ui/plugin-workflow (9.0)
body:
## Summary
Removes the dead `@object-ui/plugin-workflow` package for the planned **9.0** major.

**Why it's safe to remove** (verified by repo-wide sweep):
- `apps/console` (the bundle framework ships) and `packages/runner` never depended on it
- zero imports anywhere outside the package itself; no app/example schema uses its registered component types (`workflow-designer`, `flow-designer`, `automation-builder`, `approval-process`, `automation-run-history`)
- its designers author BPMN-style / standalone-workflow shapes the automation engine does not execute (ADR-0020, ADR-0031)

**Replacements already ship:** flow authoring → app-shell metadata-admin `FlowCanvas` (engine-registry-driven palette); run history → `FlowRunsPanel` (#1622); approval UI → framework `plugin-approvals`.

## Changes
- delete `packages/plugin-workflow/`
- delete `@object-ui/types` `workflow.ts` + its 29 type re-exports (zero external consumers — app-shell's `FlowNode`/`FlowEdge` are local types); explanatory comment left in `types/src/index.ts`
- drop docs page + `plugins/meta.json` entry, root vitest alias, changeset fixed-group entry; lockfile refreshed
- **major** changeset on `@object-ui/types` with migration notes

## Release follow-up
`npm deprecate @object-ui/plugin-workflow@"<9" "Removed in 9.0 — use the Studio flow designer (@object-ui/app-shell FlowCanvas)"`

## Test plan
- [x] full `pnpm vitest run`: 219 files / 3562 tests green
- [x] `@object-ui/types` + `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check, `@object-ui/types` build
- [x] `pnpm build:console` green; site `.source` regenerates with zero references
